sentiment.rationale: The document shows strong operational momentum: revenue up 11% YoY, EPS up 31% YoY, and net income up 23% YoY. Management explicitly guided 4Q25 NII (FTE) to $15.6B-$15.7B, up ~8% vs. 4Q24, which is a meaningful forward guidance raise. Additionally, management expects to deliver operating leverage in 4Q25. The guidance raise and confident forward language support a moderately positive score, though the score is tempered by the explicit disclosure that a 100 bps parallel shift below the forward curve would reduce NII by $2.2B over the next 12 months, indicating interest rate sensitivity risk.

Strong net income growth drove third quarter diluted earnings per share up 31% from last year. This in turn drove strong improvement in our returns on assets and equity. Revenue grew 11% year-over-year. Strong loan and deposit growth, coupled with effective balance sheet positioning, resulted in record net interest income. We also saw strong fee performance from our market-facing businesses. As revenues grew at a much faster rate than expenses, we drove good operating leverage and an efficiency ratio below 62%. With continued organic growth, every line of business reported top and bottom-line improvements. I thank our teammates for a strong quarter.
Noninterest expense of $17.3B increased $0.9B, or 5%, driven by investments in people, brand, and technology, as well as higher revenue-related expenses
